ALMANAC.gloss: an annual publication including weather forecasts and other miscellaneous information…
ALMANAC.definition: An annual publication including weather forecasts and other miscellaneous information arranged according to the calendar of a given year.

CANAL.gloss: an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels
CANAL.definition: (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels; they are now believed to be an optical illusion.

ANAL.definition: Of or related to the anus.

CLAM.gloss: burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud
CLAM.definition: Burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud; the shell closes with viselike firmness.
